scope: P-0051 life-history enrichment: historical geographical context for the independently source-proven Jomark/Bygdea life and the carefully delimited Lugnet/Overklinten kin lead
research_context: T-0012 batch 227: historical place-context enrichment for P-0051 Barbro Christina Olofsdotter's independently source-proven Jomark/Bygdea life and the carefully delimited Lugnet/Overklinten kin lead; place records must not establish identity, residence or parentage.

positive_place_records.description: By i Bygdeå socken och tingslag, nära Robertsfors bruk.
Bruksegendom i Bygdeå vid Rickleån med järnbruk, mekanisk verkstad och bland annat kvarn-, såg-, skeppsvarvs- och lastplatsanknuten verksamhet i den beskrivna egendomen.
positive_place_records.interpretation: Regional context only. Proximity between Jomark and the works does not establish employment, property affiliation or residence at Robertsfors for P-0051 or her household.

positive_place_records.interpretation: Historical-place context only for the already delimited Carl Eric Lundberg/Olaus Pehrsson kin lead. It does not place P-0051 in Öfverklinten or prove her parentage.

spelling_sensitive_queries.comparison: The historical spelling Öfverklinten returned Rosenberg 66344 under the same parish and county filters.

context_records.description: Socken och tingslag vid Bottniska viken kring Rickleån och Dalkarlsån; posten har såg- och kvarnflaggor.
context_records.interpretation: Parish-scale context only; the result does not attach P-0051 to any listed facility or activity.

interpretation: Rosenberg supplies historical environmental context for Jomark, whose connection to P-0051 between 1846 and 1913 is established by separate person-bearing church-book and census citations. The Jomark and Robertsfors entries place that proven life in a nearby industrial landscape but do not establish employment, property affiliation or residence at the works. The historical-spelling Öfverklinten entry contextualises only the already source-delimited Lundberg/Olaus lead; it does not connect P-0051 to the village or make Olaus Pehrsson her father.
limitations: The geographical lexicon does not name Barbro Christina Olofsdotter or any member of her household.
P-0051's residence and long life in Jomark are established only by the existing person-bearing citations.
Proximity to Robertsfors does not establish that P-0051 or her relatives worked for, lived at or held property under the works.
Robertsfors industry flags must not replace the household sources' descriptions of P-0051 as a farm-owner's daughter or of her husband as a former farm owner.
The Öfverklinten record supplies context for a kin lead only and does not establish P-0051's birthplace, residence or parentage.
Olaus Pehrsson remains an unproven father candidate; no biological relation is created.
The Lugnet and modern-spelling Överklinten no-results are lexicon-, spelling-, parish-filter- and query-field-bounded, not place, residence, person or relationship nulls.
No person, relationship, birth identity, parent, occupation or new residence event was created from these records.
